title: 2–3 Layer Functional Road/Building Surface Pilot Packet
objective: Pilot a maintainable multifunction surface stack while keeping conventional protective performance separable from experimental sensing/energy/resonant features.
default_stack: L2 optional function layer: sensing / conductive / thermal / optical / communications geometry
geospatial_biofeedback_boundary: Any geospatial or biofeedback claim must name sensor input, measurable physical mechanism, actuator/output, control law, exposure pathway and falsification test; otherwise keep it as a frontier hypothesis.
governance: no safety-critical automated control without independent authority
